draftContext.markdown:
Editorial pipeline: #450 (Oct 25 review draft) is sequenced first; #452 (Oct 26) follows. Both are in draft independent-review state and neither has been admitted. Next step for each is review draft merge, then correction if warranted, then acceptance, then accepted-source verification, then conditional held-action step.

Core #572: draft, self-reviewed only, factual defect in `eli` worked example. Acceptance criterion is owner verification of corrected facts against primary source. No CI gate catches cross-register divergence. No target date set.

Core #571 existing-hook migration: the PR does not automatically migrate installations with legacy telemetry hooks registered under the old behavior. This is an open owner gate — rollout review of existing hook migration behavior has not been scheduled or assigned.

Issue #386 (token budget ceiling): 250,399-byte discussion against 131,072-byte source limit is the documented failure mode. #462 does not address it. No owner, no target, no stated consequence threshold documented.

Morning-cockpit #60: open since October 21, passed Claude Opus review, no documented blocker. Disposition unknown — requires owner decision on whether to merge or close.

Classic-space-venue #4: active research surface for RFI-0002 / core #567 cluster. Updated this window but not merged. No action required unless the research dependency on core #567 advances.

Gate 02 / Selfco Sync replacement cutover: execution-pending, recovery owner holds ordered handoff runbook. Not yet executed. No completion date recorded.
